story.title: Our story
story.text: Lumen started with a simple observation: the best evenings begin with lighting a candle. We create compositions that change the mood of a room in minutes and never tire you after an hour.
story.text2: We don't chase seasonal launches. The collection is small because every scent has to stand on its own: smelling just as beautiful the first time you light it as the last. Only the compositions you want to light evening after evening make the cut.

process.title: Our process
process.text: We build every scent like a perfume: a top for the first minutes, a heart for the evening, a base for what lingers. The wax is hand-poured in small batches.
process.text2: After pouring, the candles cure for 2 weeks so the scent can fully bind with the wax. We test every batch by burning it ourselves, checking the flame, the even melt and how the scent fills a room. Only then does a candle go into its box.

materials.title: Our materials
materials.text: 100% natural rapeseed wax from European crops, with no paraffin and no additives. It burns cleanly and slowly, so the scent spreads evenly all evening.
materials.text2: Add a cotton wick with no metal core, natural essential oils and tinted glass that stays with you once the candle is finished. Packed in cardboard and paper, no plastic.

Don't burn for more than 4 hours at a time.
Never leave a burning candle unattended.

about.title: Candles for people who know how to slow down
about.intro: Lumen started with a simple observation: the best evenings begin with lighting a candle. We create compositions that change the mood of a room in minutes and never tire you after an hour.

compose.title: Composition
compose.text: We build every scent like a perfume: a top note for the first minutes, a heart for the evening, a base for what lingers in the room.

pour.title: Pouring
pour.text: Wax is hand-poured in small batches, so we control the temperature and the even spread of the oils.

cure.title: Curing
cure.text: Before a candle is packed, the wax cures for 2 weeks so the scent can fully bind.

pack.title: Packing
pack.text: We pack in cardboard and paper so the glass arrives intact and the packaging goes straight into paper recycling.

about.note: We wanted candles that smell like a memory, not like an air freshener. Candles you light for no occasion, because the evening itself is the occasion. We hope Lumen becomes a small ritual in your home too.
